aDEFECTTHISLANECAUSEDANDUNDIDANDWILLNAME.whyItIsWORTHRECORDING: scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/identity-refresh.mjs was written precisely to stop a rebuild erasing that annotation, and it does stop a SUCCESSFUL rebuild. It does not stop a FAILED rebuild followed by a successful one, because the failure destroys the evidence the module reads. Seventeen families are recorded as resting on these annotations. Out of scope for this lane's grant; named so it is not lost.

rasterPixelCounts.theseAGREEWITHVF56ATTHEOTHERRESOLUTION: VF56 measured the same pages at 150 dpi and published 846 / 1,298 / 994 and 474 / 488 where this lane measures 3,511 / 5,189 / 4,086 and 1,973 / 1,996 at 300 dpi. Two lanes, two resolutions, one page.

aDEFECTINTHEFACTORYTHISLANEHITANDNAMED: A build that fails an assertion AFTER the felony-seal builder wipes its output directory destroys the hand-written identityRefresh annotation that the NEXT successful build would have carried forward, because preserveIdentityRefresh reads the file the failure deleted and is fail-safe on a missing file. The rebuild then reports success with all nine counters zero. identity-refresh.mjs stops a successful rebuild erasing that annotation; it does not stop a failed one followed by a successful one. Seventeen families are recorded as resting on these annotations.
